mapping_json.fidelity_notes: ITEM-KEYSTONE ECONOMY-ARCHETYPE kit (no signature damage skill -- the FRAME is the identity, verified: 'primary spell varies by era; the Shavronne's + Pain Attunement frame is the constant'). Crosswalk s4 names this kit's item CLASS by name: economy-warping (Shavronne's low-life) -> resource_economy keys + DEFENSIVE_TRADEOFF/SACRIFICE_ASCENDANCY when the warp IS the identity -- deterministic row applies, so the ITEM DISSOLVES into reservation_percent=0.65 + reservation_resource=hp (b02 blood-magic-kit precedent for hp-pool economy keys; 0.65 sits under the 0.75 LOCK and pins the character below a 35%-of-life line). Pain Attunement (s5 life/defense-trade row, named) + the low-life sacrifice register -> DEFENSIVE_TRADEOFF + SACRIFICE_ASCENDANCY; the aura-stacking payload ('run auras previously only accessible on ES') -> NETWORK_AMPLIFIER (s5 aura-amp row). THRESHOLD note: the source payoff is conditional-below-35%, but because reservation PINS the character there permanently, the lived experience is a static trade -- which is what the doors model; the knife's-edge framing survives as flavor. Shavronne's chaos-does-not-bypass-ES mechanic solves a SOURCE-GAME problem (chaos/ES bypass) that has no engine analog to break -- nothing to map, recorded here per the epistemics wall. Flag (d) player test: lanes DO express the warp (named s4 row) -> not GAPPED; no docket.
